props.text: A simple fox face from one square of paper: no cutting, about five minutes. Orange on one side and white on the other works best.
Place the square white side up, with a corner pointing at you.
6. Turn over and add a face
Sharp creases make the difference: run a fingernail along each fold before the next one.
